target.title: fix(ui): keep event payload previews UTF-16 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users viewing the Overview event log would see a broken payload preview when the 120-character preview boundary landed inside an emoji or other UTF-16 surrogate pair.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Overview preview now uses a shared event payload preview formatter that keeps the existing 120 UTF-16 code unit budget but backs off when the boundary would split a surrogate pair. This is limited to the Overview preview; full debug payload rendering, payload data, API/schema, and event storage are unchanged.

## User Impact

Overview event payload previews remain bounded and no longer display malformed emoji or replacement characters for event payloads containing astral Unicode characters near the preview boundary.

## Evidence

- Pre-submit guard: latest `origin/main` at `b23fdcfac953d80b2e7d29bcf311e7f64b45ab7b` still used `formatEventPayload(entry.payload).slice(0, 120)` in `ui/src/pages/overview/event-log.ts`; open PR searches for `formatEventPayload slice`, `UTF-16 payload preview`, and `event-log payload` returned no matching open PRs.
- Browser issue-path proof: Vite Control UI in Chromium on `/overview` received a gateway event whose legacy preview ended on high surrogate `55357`; rendered `.ov-event-log-payload` had length `119` and last code unit `97`, so it did not end with a dangling surrogate.

```text
{
  "browserUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:44315/overview",
  "legacySliceLastCodeUnit": 55357,
  "previewLength": 119,
  "previewLastCodeUnit": 97,
  "previewTail": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
}
```
